subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should Android follow-up preserve the current gateway.nodes.allowCommands and node reapproval gates while fixing diagnostics/reproduction, or intentionally change the camera/location command exposure contract?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and current source shows both implementations and security gates, so changing exposure policy is a maintainer security/product decision rather than a safe cleanup close or autonomous fix.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run live current-main Android proof, keep camera.snap/camera.clip behind explicit gateway.nodes.allowCommands, and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Broaden Android camera or location exposure only with explicit security approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after repro
options.body: If live proof shows independent camera, location, and A2UI causes, split the remaining work into separate owner-reviewed fixes.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run live current-main Android proof, keep camera.snap/camera.clip behind explicit gateway.nodes.allowCommands, and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is Android app behavior plus sensitive node command exposure, and obviyus is the declared Android area contact in repo docs.
